page.content:
The Shape — silent killer who comes home on Halloween.

How Michael Myers connects

  • Work: Halloween (1978) — Halloween (1978) is the night Michael comes home.
  • Faction: Myers family — Michael is the Myers child who becomes the Shape.
  • Concept: The Shape — Michael is billed and remembered as the Shape.
  • Character: Laurie Strode — Laurie is the first babysitter who fights Michael and lives.
  • Item: The mask — Michael wears the blank mask that makes him the Shape.
  • Character: Dr. Sam Loomis — Loomis spends the night trying to stop Michael.
  • Weapon: Kitchen knife — Michael kills with a kitchen knife taken from ordinary rooms.
  • Location: Haddonfield — Michael returns to walk Haddonfield.
  • Location: Smith's Grove Sanitarium — Michael was held at Smith's Grove until the 1978 escape.

What is Michael Myers?

Michael Myers is the masked figure who murders Judith as a child, escapes Smith's Grove, and stalks Haddonfield with a kitchen knife and almost no speech.

Key threads lead to Halloween (1978), Myers family, The Shape, Laurie Strode, The mask and Dr. Sam Loomis.
